scope: Supplement only from existing tool receipts and carried summary; no new evidence review or experiment run.

The carried summary of earlier B/C review batches does not contain historical OS identities or complete commands. No absent process identity is reconstructed or guessed.
The exact submitted shell commands remain in the tool transcript. Submitted shell/cmd inputs are not asserted to be the complete actual OS argv.
Actual exit_code=0 is confirmed for the two visible reader/writer calls below. This is a process-exit receipt, not an independent PID/start-time closure.
No shell process is started by this supplement. The one JSON deliverable is written directly through apply_patch. Internal tool-service process metadata is not exposed.
